description: See a Pinterest AD before spending — Pinterest renders a preview link (valid 7 days, iframe-able) from an existing promotable Pin (pinId), from an image not yet pinned (imageUrl + title), or from a catalog product group (productGroupId, for a shopping ad). Creates no ad, spends nothing, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

creativeType.description: pin: SHOPPING, COLLECTION, MAX_VIDEO, MAX_WIDTH_VIDEO_COLLECTION, MAX_WIDTH_REGULAR_COLLECTION; product group: SHOPPING, COLLECTION, CAROUSEL, MAX_WIDTH_COLLECTION

imageUrl.description: public image URL to preview before it is pinned; needs title

itemId.description: catalog item (product) id to preview within the product group

pinId.description: existing promotable Pin id to preview

productGroupId.description: catalog product group id, for a shopping ad preview

name: preview_pinterest_ads_ad
title: Preview a Pinterest ad
